zh.title: 華航9月16日起調漲貨運燃油附加費 歐美線每公斤62元
zh.summary: 中華航空9月16日起調漲台灣出口貨運燃油附加費，歐美長程每公斤62元。
body: 中華航空向貨運代理商發布通知，因應國際油價波動，將自2026年9月16日凌晨零時起調漲台灣地區出口貨物燃油附加費。除基本運價貨物免予徵收外，其餘出口貨物均按計價重量徵收燃油附加費。
依據華航調整通知，第一區與第二區等歐美長程航線燃油附加費每公斤調升新台幣4元至62元，漲幅約6.9%；第三區亞洲短程航線燃油附加費每公斤調升1元至21元，漲幅約5%。華航先前已於9月初將長程線調升至58元、短程線調升至20元。

en.title: China Airlines to Raise Cargo Fuel Surcharges from Sept 16
en.summary: China Airlines will adjust Taiwan export cargo fuel surcharges from September 16 to reflect fuel cost pressures.
body: China Airlines has notified freight forwarders that it will increase fuel surcharges on export cargo from Taiwan starting September 16, 2026, to reflect fluctuations in global oil prices. Except for basic rate cargo, all exported goods will be subject to the fuel surcharge based on chargeable weight.

Under the adjustment, fuel surcharges for Zone 1 and Zone 2 long-haul routes to Europe and America will rise by NT$4 to NT$62 per kilogram, an increase of about 6.9 percent. Surcharges for Zone 3 short-haul Asian routes will rise by NT$1 to NT$21 per kilogram, an increase of about 5 percent. China Airlines previously raised long-haul surcharges to NT$58 and short-haul to NT$20 in early September.

zh.title: 亞馬遜貨機於邁阿密衝出跑道釀至少5死 NTSB展開調查
zh.summary: 21 Air執飛亞馬遜767貨機於邁阿密衝出跑道釀5死；NTSB展開調查。
body: 2026年9月6日下午，一架由21 Air代表亞馬遜航空（Amazon Air）營運的波音767-300貨機（航班號為7598），在執行從波多黎各聖胡安路易斯·穆尼奧斯·馬林國際機場飛往美國邁阿密國際機場（MIA）的航程後，於邁阿密著陸時衝出30號跑道。根據航班追蹤資料顯示，該架貨機在離開跑道可用表面時，對地速度高達112節（相當於每小時約207公里）。該機隨後衝破機場周邊圍籬並進入外圍公共道路，撞擊多輛行駛與停放的車輛。
這起嚴重的跑道衝出事故造成至少5人死亡、5人受傷，其中有3名傷者情況危殆並已被緊急送醫救治，而機上的2名飛行員則順利生還。邁阿密-戴德消防救援局投入超過60個救援單位及約200名消防救援人員，緊急展開搜救行動。救援團隊從被撞擊的車輛下方救出受困民眾，並派出一級危險物品處置小組關閉事故飛機發動機並控制現場的燃料洩漏狀況。
飛機著陸當時的氣象報告（METAR）顯示，邁阿密國際機場周邊出現雷雨天氣，風向190度、風力17節且陣風達到26節，跑道表面處於濕滑狀態。調查人員目前尚未對事故原因做出結論，將針對跑道表面狀況、煞車效能、觸地位置、反推力器與減速板運作情形以及著陸重量等多項技術因素進行深入調查。
美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）主席珍妮佛·霍曼迪（Jennifer Homendy）已率領調查小組抵達邁阿密現場，並由美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）同步配合調查。飛機製造商波音公司與營運商21 Air均表示將全面配合聯邦調查官員。亞馬遜公司亦發表聲明表達哀悼，並承諾配合官方調查。

en.title: Amazon Air Boeing 767 Overruns Miami Runway at 112 Knots, Killing at Least Five
en.summary: A 21 Air Boeing 767 operating for Amazon Air overran a Miami runway, killing at least five people.
body: On September 6, 2026, a Boeing 767-300 freighter operating as Flight 7598 by 21 Air on behalf of Amazon Air overran Runway 30 during landing at Miami International Airport (MIA) in the United States, following a flight from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (SJU) in San Juan, Puerto Rico. According to flight tracking data, the cargo aircraft was travelling at a ground speed of 112 knots (approximately 129 mph or 207 km/h) when it left the usable runway surface. The aircraft continued past the airfield boundary and perimeter fence, coming to rest on a public road where it struck multiple vehicles.

The crash killed at least five people and injured five others, with three of those transported to medical facilities reported in critical condition. Both pilots aboard the freighter survived the overrun. Miami-Dade Fire Rescue deployed over 60 units and roughly 200 emergency personnel to the scene. First responders extricated victims trapped near struck vehicles and dispatched hazardous materials crews to shut down an aircraft engine and contain a fuel leak.

Weather observations (METAR) recorded around the time of landing indicated active thunderstorms over the airport, with winds from 190 degrees at 17 knots gusting to 26 knots, along with wet runway conditions. Federal authorities noted that official investigations have not yet established the cause of the runway excursion, with factors such as touchdown point, braking efficiency, thrust reverser functionality, and landing weight expected to undergo review.

A National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) go-team led by Chair Jennifer Homendy arrived on site at Miami International Airport to initiate a formal investigation alongside the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). Aircraft manufacturer Boeing and operator 21 Air confirmed full cooperation with federal investigators, while Amazon expressed condolences to the families of those affected and stated it is working closely with officials.

zh.title: 空中巴士A330neo交付延誤 影響赴美航線高端客艙推廣
zh.summary: 空中巴士A330neo交付曾暫停數月；航機延誤影響美國航線佈局
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日的報導，空中巴士（Airbus）A330neo 客機交付發生延誤，已對該機型的整體交付進度，以及赴美國航線主打高比例商務與豪經艙（premium-heavy）的客艙配置推廣計畫造成影響。
報導指出，空中巴士 A330neo 機型的交付作業在今年早些時候曾暫停數月之久。雖然報導標題提及工具遺失相關疑慮，但目前公開資訊尚未揭露受影響業者的具體細節與後續修正時程。

en.title: Airbus A330neo Delivery Delays Impact Premium Cabin Rollout on US Routes
en.summary: Airbus A330neo deliveries faced months of pauses, impacting premium rollout on US flights.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying on September 7, 2026, aircraft manufacturer Airbus has experienced delivery delays affecting its A330neo widebody aircraft. These delays have impacted overall aircraft deliveries as well as the planned rollout of premium-heavy cabin seating configurations on flights operating to the United States.

The reporting indicates that deliveries of the Airbus A330neo model were paused for several months earlier in the year. Although headline reporting referenced questions concerning lost tooling, further details regarding specific airline operators or revised delivery timelines were not immediately available in the released excerpt.

zh.title: 荷蘭PAL-V飛行車獲EASA生產組織批准書
zh.summary: 荷蘭PAL-V飛行車取得EASA生產批准，預計將於2028年開始首批交付。
body: 荷蘭飛行車開發商 PAL-V 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日證實，該公司已正式獲得歐洲航空安全局（EASA）頒發的歐洲生產組織批准書（POA）。這項進展標誌著該公司在將認證的 FlyDrive 行動解決方案推向市場的過程中，邁出了極為關鍵的一步。該項批准確認了 PAL-V 具備製造航空產品的資質。
根據 PAL-V 的說法，該公司是先進空中交通（AAM）領域中，第一家獲得此項生產組織批准書的 FlyDrive 開發商，這使其在該領域的競爭中領先於美國與中國的相關計畫。PAL-V 執行長 Robert Dingemanse 指出，取得生產組織批准書是一項重大的里程碑。這不僅證實了公司已開發出突破性的 FlyDrive 產品平台，也確認其建立了一個有能力開發、認證並製造適航產品的世界級組織。
這家總部位於荷蘭拉姆斯東克斯費爾（Raamsdonksveer）的開發商表示，公司目前已取得數個關鍵的認證里程碑，包括在 2025 年獲得歐洲航空安全局（EASA）核發的「無技術反對」（No Technical Objection）聲明。此外，該公司亦擁有汽車生產的核准文件，使其能夠在工業化規模上製造其產品。
PAL-V 預計將於 2028 年進行其飛行車的首批交付。根據該公司的說法，其預訂訂單量已足夠填滿前三年的生產線。在 2024 年 3 月，PAL-V 曾接獲來自杜拜（Dubai）航太公司 Aviterra 的 100 輛飛行車訂單。在飛行性能方面，該款車輛在飛行時的航程可達 500 公里，最大速度則可達到每小時 180 公里。

en.title: Dutch Flying Car Developer PAL-V Secures EASA Production Organization Approval
en.summary: PAL-V secures EASA production organization approval; first deliveries of flying cars are expected in 2028.
body: Dutch flying car developer PAL-V confirmed on September 7, 2026, that it has secured its European Production Organization Approval (POA) from the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA). According to the company, this milestone represents a significant step toward bringing its certified FlyDrive mobility solutions to the commercial market, granting it the authorization to manufacture aviation products.

PAL-V stated that it is the first FlyDrive developer within the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) sector to receive this approval, placing the company ahead of rival initiatives in both the United States and China. Robert Dingemanse, CEO of PAL-V, emphasized that obtaining the POA confirms the company has established a world-class organization capable of developing, certifying, and manufacturing airworthy products based on its proprietary platform.

Headquartered in Raamsdonksveer, the developer also holds automotive production approvals, which allow it to manufacture its products on an industrial scale. The latest POA follows several other critical certification achievements, including the receipt of a "No Technical Objection" statement from EASA in 2025. The company stated that these milestones validate nearly two decades of development, certification, and regulatory expertise.

The manufacturer expects to begin the initial deliveries of its flying car in 2028. PAL-V reported that its current reservation portfolio is already sufficient to cover the first three years of production capacity. This backlog includes a March 2024 order for 100 units from Aviterra, a Dubai-based aerospace firm backed by the owners of executive aviation firm Jetex. In flight, the vehicle has a stated maximum speed of 180 km/h and an operational range of 500 km.

zh.title: IAI完成空中巴士A330客改貨機首飛
zh.summary: IAI完成A330-300BDSF客改貨機首飛；設計載重達61噸。
body: 以色列航太工業（IAI）宣布，已成功完成其空中巴士（Airbus）A330-300客機改裝貨機（A330-300BDSF）的首次飛行。此次首飛是該機型認證程序的一部分，此前該機已完成了主要結構階段以及由IAI航空集團進行的地面測試。
根據IAI資料，A330-300BDSF客改貨機設計可容納多達30個貨櫃，最大載重能力達61噸，旨在為區域與中程航線的貨運業者提供具競爭力的選擇。該機型配備了電動貨物裝載系統，並在主甲板前部設有貨艙門以加速裝卸。
此計畫是IAI首度將空中巴士寬體客機納入其客改貨產品線。目前其改裝陣容涵蓋了波音777-300ERSF、波音767-200、波音767-300，以及波音737-700（ICAO機型代碼B737）與737-800等機型。

en.title: IAI Completes Maiden Flight of Converted Airbus A330-300 Freighter
en.summary: IAI has completed the maiden flight of its newly converted Airbus A330-300BDSF cargo aircraft.
body: Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) has announced the completion of the maiden flight of its converted Airbus A330-300 passenger-to-freighter aircraft, designated as the A330-300BDSF. The flight, conducted as part of the certification campaign, followed ground testing by IAI's Aviation Group.

The A330-300BDSF is designed to carry up to 30 containers with a maximum payload capability of up to 61 tons, serving regional and medium-haul cargo routes. The aircraft is equipped with an electrical cargo loading system and a forward-positioned main deck cargo door to optimize turnaround times.

This program introduces the first Airbus widebody to IAI’s conversion lineup. Its current portfolio also includes the Boeing 777-300ERSF, Boeing 767-200, Boeing 767-300, Boeing 737-700 (ICAO type code B737), and Boeing 737-800 platforms.

zh.title: Beechcraft單引擎飛機澳洲布里斯本墜毀釀兩死
zh.summary: Beechcraft輕型飛機於澳洲布里斯本墜毀釀2死；澳洲交通安全局已啟動事故調查
body: 澳洲昆士蘭州布里斯本南部的洛根地方政府轄區斯托克利（Stockleigh）於2026年9月7日發生起輕型飛機墜毀事故。緊急救援單位在當地時間上午11時10分左右接獲報案，指出 Musch Road 一處鄉村農地有飛機墜落。救援人員抵達現場後，證實機上兩名乘員已當場死亡。
涉事飛機為一架1979年製造的 Beechcraft A36 Bonanza 單引擎小型飛機，國籍標誌暨登記號碼為 VH-MPT，序號為 E-1456，登記營運者為 Telford Aviation。警方初步調查顯示，該機於上午10時57分自位於布里斯本市中心南方約11公里的阿徹菲爾德機場（Archerfield Airport，代碼YBAF）起飛，隨後在不久後發生墜機事故。
飛機墜毀時在農地現場引發草地火災，救援人員抵達後迅速展開撲救，火勢在大約一小時內獲得控制。警方證實現場無任何地面人員受傷，周邊住宅亦未受到損耗或破壞。警方隨後在現場建立安全警戒線，並呼籲曾目擊飛機飛行過程或擁有相關影像資料的民眾提供資訊。
澳洲交通安全局（ATSB）已針對本起空難正式啟動交通安全調查，並自布里斯本辦事處派遣三名調查人員前往現場。調查團隊將勘查事故現場與飛機殘骸，並將相關零組件送往坎培拉的技術設施進行分析，同時收集飛行追蹤數據、機師與維修紀錄及氣象資料，預計在大約八週內發表初步報告。

en.title: Two Killed in Beechcraft Bonanza Light Aircraft Crash Near Brisbane, Australia
en.summary: A Beechcraft Bonanza light aircraft crashed near Brisbane, Australia, killing two people and triggering a safety investigation.
body: Two people were killed on September 7, 2026, when a light aircraft crashed onto a rural property at Stockleigh in the Logan local government area south of Brisbane, Australia. Emergency services responded to reports of the aviation accident on Musch Road at approximately 11:10 local time, where first responders found both occupants deceased at the scene.

The aircraft involved was identified as a 1979-built single-engine Beechcraft A36 Bonanza with registration VH-MPT and serial number E-1456, listed as registered to Telford Aviation. Police inquiries established that the flight had departed Archerfield Airport (YBAF), located roughly 11 kilometers south of central Brisbane, at 10:57 local time. Unconfirmed flight tracking estimates indicated that the duration of the flight lasted between 10 and 18 minutes.

The crash ignited a grass fire across the property, which emergency responders managed to contain within about an hour. Officials confirmed that no residents or bystanders on the ground sustained any injuries and no nearby homes were damaged. Queensland Police established a safety cordon at the site, while local commanders requested witnesses who observed the aircraft or possessed relevant video footage to contact authorities.

The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) announced that it has commenced a formal safety investigation into the accident and dispatched three investigators from its Brisbane office. The investigation team will conduct site examinations, retrieve components for analysis at technical facilities in Canberra, gather pilot and maintenance records, and examine local weather conditions. The bureau anticipates releasing a preliminary investigation report in approximately eight weeks.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空10月暫停A380飛往荷蘭航班 11月航班將倍增
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空10月暫停荷蘭A380航班；航線服務預計於11月增加一倍
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，阿聯酋航空（Emirates）旗下的空中巴士 A380 客機將於 10 月停止營運飛往荷蘭的航班。不過，相關報告同時指出，阿聯酋航空飛往荷蘭的航班數量預計將於 11 月增加至雙倍。
根據 AVWIRE 歷史紀錄資料，阿聯酋航空在 2026 年夏季期間，曾暫時暫停前往布拉格與格拉斯哥的空中巴士 A380 客機航班服務。當時的紀錄顯示，該航空公司預計於 10 月恢復布拉格與格拉斯哥的每日空中巴士 A380 巨無霸客機服務。
此外，歷史紀錄亦顯示，阿聯酋航空工程部門先前曾推動一項數十億美元的投資計畫，用以全面翻新旗下 219 架空中巴士 A380 與波音 777 客機。

en.title: Emirates to Suspend Airbus A380 Flights to the Netherlands in October
en.summary: Emirates will suspend Airbus A380 flights to the Netherlands in October before doubling services in November.
body: According to reporting from Simple Flying, Emirates will no longer operate Airbus A380 flights to the Netherlands during the month of October. However, the same operational schedule indicates that the carrier's Airbus A380 flights to the Netherlands will double in November.

According to verified historical context, Emirates temporarily suspended its Airbus A380 flights to Prague and Glasgow for summer 2026. The carrier expected daily superjumbo services to Prague and Glasgow to return in October.
Additionally, historical records show that Emirates Engineering previously launched a multi-billion-dollar investment to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft across its fleet.

zh.title: 航空回收業者面臨空中巴士A350與波音787回收難題
zh.summary: 航空回收業者不願接收空中巴士A350與波音787，面臨永續挑戰。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，航空回收業者對於接收空中巴士（Airbus）A350 與波音（Boeing）787 客機面臨阻礙。這兩種機型的回收問題，可能成為航空業面臨的最大永續挑戰之一。
目前客機製造商正在展開競爭，試圖在這些客機開始大規模退役之前，儘速解決相關的回收難題。
根據本站歷史資料紀錄，這兩款機型在全球擁有大量訂單與部署。例如 United Airlines 已針對其機隊進行重組，其中包含訂購大量波音 787 客機，並同時面臨可能影響 45 架空中巴士 A350 客機的 Rolls-Royce 引擎爭議。

en.title: Recyclers Reluctant to Accept Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 Aircraft
en.summary: Aircraft recyclers avoid Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 models, posing sustainability challenges for manufacturers.
body: According to Simple Flying, aircraft recyclers are reluctant to take Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 models. Recycling these two aircraft types could develop into one of the aviation industry's most significant sustainability challenges.
Currently, manufacturers are racing against time to find viable solutions to this recycling bottleneck before both aircraft models begin to retire in large numbers.

Historically, both models have seen extensive adoption. According to AVWIRE verified records, United Airlines has been reshaping its fleet with a massive order for Boeing 787 aircraft, while simultaneously dealing with an engine durability dispute that puts 45 Airbus A350 jets at risk.

zh.title: 瑞典ASC 890預警機在烏克蘭完成首次戰鬥任務
zh.summary: 瑞典ASC 890預警機3月在烏克蘭首秀；烏國防部9月4日證實
body: 烏克蘭國防部於9月4日發布的空軍能力聯盟說明文件中確認，瑞典提供的ASC 890空中預警管制機已於2026年3月在烏克蘭上空執行首批戰鬥任務，這是該型機自交付以來首次公開承認進入實戰運作。
ASC 890是烏克蘭獲得的首款專用空中預警管制平台，填補了烏克蘭空軍長期缺乏專用預警機的空白。該機型基於薩博340支線渦槳飛機改裝，裝備伊利鷹有源電子掃描陣列雷達，儀表測程達450公里，對戰機級目標在強雜波干擾下仍可探測約350公里。
瑞典於2024年5月作為第16批軍援套餐宣佈移交ASC 890，烏克蘭國防部於2025年8月確認接收，隨後在2026年3月實現首秀。瑞典此前已訂購兩架環球眼（S 106）作為替代機型，並計劃2027年投入使用以彌補能力缺口。
烏克蘭國防部指出，ASC 890將與F-16、幻影2000和獅鷲戰機共同構建符合北約標準的網絡中心空中作戰體系。同時，薩博於2026年6月30日與瑞典國防物資管理局簽署合同，向烏克蘭提供16架新建獅鷲E型戰機，合同金額約246億瑞典克朗（約25億美元），交付期定於2029至2030年。
瑞典另承諾從現役庫存中撥付16架較早期的獅鷲C/D型戰機作為軍事援助，預計2027年初開始交付。這些安排顯示瑞典與北約夥伴正加快強化烏克蘭空中作戰能力。

en.title: Swedish ASC 890 AEW&C aircraft flies first combat sorties over Ukraine
en.summary: Ukraine confirms Swedish ASC 890 AEW&C flew first combat sorties in March.
body: Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence confirmed on 4 September 2026 that the Swedish‑supplied ASC 890 airborne early warning and control aircraft flew its first combat sorties over Ukraine in March 2026, marking the type’s operational debut after delivery.

The ASC 890 is Ukraine’s first dedicated AEW&C platform. It is a Saab 340 regional turboprop fitted with the Erieye active electronically scanned array radar, which Saab rates at an instrumented range of 450 kilometres and a detection range of about 350 kilometres against fighter‑sized targets in heavy clutter or jamming. The fixed antenna covers 150 degrees to each side, leaving blind sectors directly ahead and behind the aircraft.

Sweden announced the transfer in May 2024 as part of its 16th military aid package, and Ukraine confirmed receipt in August 2025. Sweden had already ordered two GlobalEye aircraft (designated S 106) in June 2022 and exercised an option for a third in June 2024, with entry into service expected in 2027 to offset the capability gap.

The ministry said the ASC 890 will form the backbone of a NATO‑aligned network‑centric air combat system together with the F‑16, Mirage 2000 and Gripen fighters. On 30 June 2026 Saab signed a contract with the Swedish Defence Materiel Administration for 16 new‑build Gripen E fighters for Ukraine, valued at roughly SEK 24.6 billion (about US$2.5 billion), with deliveries slated for 2029 and 2030.

Sweden has also pledged 16 older‑generation Gripen C/D aircraft from its own inventory as military aid, with deliveries expected to begin in early 2027. These commitments illustrate the accelerating effort by Sweden and its NATO partners to reinforce Ukraine’s air combat capabilities.
